name: [UPDATE 2.3] Attack On Titan: Vengeance
desc:
Welcome to Attack on Titan: Vengeance, a challenging and rewarding 

Fight to reclaim the walls, explore the Giant Forest, defend fortresses against relentless waves of Titans, take on powerful Berserker Titans, climb the leaderboards, and team up with friends to restore peace to Paradis.

⚔️ Designed to be challenging
Unlike many Attack on Titan games, Vengeance is built around skill, teamwork, and progression. Titans are more dangerous, combat is less forgiving, and mastering your ODM Gear is essential.

📱 Full Mobile, Xbox & PlayStation Support

✨ 1.5x XP Every Weekend

🎁 Next Code at 50,000 Likes!

💬 Join our Discord server for the latest codes, updates, FAQs, and community events.

👥 Official Group:
https://www.roblox.com/groups/9723353/AOT-V-Attack-on-Titan-Vengeance
